notes.edge_semantics: Pair edges outside Direction are shared-pattern membership or exact same-time same-direction mover co-occurrence; no causal relationship is asserted.
notes.direction_semantics: Direction uses qualified pattern hyperedges: each synthetic hub is one qualified pattern and spokes connect its actual member symbols. No symbol-to-symbol causal edge is implied.
notes.qualification_semantics: Qualified means historical V4.78 statistical/economic gates passed; not a guaranteed trade.
notes.hot_semantics: Hot is a visualization rule only: net>=5%, directional>=80%, holdout_n>=12, q<=0.05. It does not promote a trade.
notes.conflict_semantics: Conflict means a symbol currently has historically qualified RISE and FALL patterns. It is diagnostic, not a trade direction.
notes.fire_rate_semantics: For a qualified symbol, 60-day fire rate reconstructs its selected best qualified CORE/FLOW/FULL signature from raw mover-event signatures and counts distinct observed market dates on which that exact family+signature+direction fired at least once in the latest up-to-60 observed market-day window. Repeated intraday fires count once. Unqualified symbols fall back to any mover-event day. Frequency is not quality or causality.
notes.expanded_universe_semantics: Magnitude is raw observed mover size, Frequency is distinct observed fire-day density, Generalization is train-vs-holdout hit-rate agreement, and Immediacy is the inverse normalized horizon of the strongest-net historical candidate. These are observational lenses, not additional qualification gates.
notes.sector_gravity_semantics: Sector gravity uses Nasdaq screener sector metadata when available, cached outside research authority. Larger observed sectors have greater visual mass; this never changes qualification or trading authority.
notes.write_safety: Publisher reads completed checkpoints only and never mutates Argus research artifacts.
